coordinate_system: Ernie MRI coordinates: X right, Y anterior, Z superior; millimetres

roi_definition.rule: A face belongs to an ROI only when all three native vertices have labels in the same ROI. Off-dictionary sources inherit their original parent face. Mixed and unassigned faces remain unassigned.

provenance.source_orientation: frozen unit cortical normals, same order as the forward columns

limitations: These are the original off-dictionary generation locations, not a continuous draggable source model.
The normal is an immutable physical direction used in the stored FEM column, not an editable arrow.
ROIs merge native DK40 labels using the published mapping table; mixed-ROI boundary faces and ungrouped parcels remain unassigned. The head model is Ernie.
